propositions: Record an ADR (0100) documenting the approved CLI architecture: stdlib-only immutable lazy command registry with pre-operation help/alias/capability routing before config and handler resolution.
Establish single-source-of-truth parser-factory pattern where argparse definitions serve both runtime parsing and deterministic generated help/syntax documentation.
Define semantic capability registry with four enforcement postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) mapped to packaging extras and applied after mode/backend selection.
Document alias taxonomy and routing precedence (canonical/exact/compatibility/hidden/retired) with bridge-shim migration path, prohibiting docs-only grammars.
Update docs/architecture.md with implemented CLI boundary and ADR 0100 link; regenerate index and marker artifacts with gen_adr_index.py and verify with check_adr_numbers.py.
Resolve research critique (assumptions, dependencies, unanswered questions, conflicts with ADR 0098) before drafting; obtain explicit maintainer approval of exact ADR draft before Gerrit Submit.
